summary: Highland County, Virginia, lookout station on Jack Mountain; a February 1928 item says it was phoned to Monterey and Doe Hill; the Association lists the site as gone.

facts.agency: State and county (1928 station, per Forest Lookouts)
facts.status_note: Association lists the type as Unknown and the status as Gone; no removal date in the sources read.

events.note: Feb. 17, 1928 Highland Recorder item, quoted by Forest Lookouts: state and county lookout station on Jack Mountain, connected by telephone to Monterey and Doe Hill

evidence.supports: 1928 station on Jack Mountain, maintained by the state and county, connected by telephone to Monterey and Doe Hill
evidence.quote: lookout station maintained by the state and county at Riven Rock on Jack mountain is connected by telephone with switchboard at Monterey, and Doe Hill

evidence.supports: Date of the Highland Recorder item
Chief warden asked local wardens to urge neighbors to respond promptly if a forest fire started in their neighborhood
evidence.quote: requested the local wardens to urge the neighbors to respond promptly

evidence.supports: The request came from the chief warden
Neighbors respond promptly if a forest fire started in their neighborhood
evidence.quote: in the event a forest fire gets started in their neighborhood

evidence.supports: Association list: Riven Rock, Highland County, coordinates, type Unknown, status Gone
Association lists Sounding Knob as a separate entry with other coordinates, status Tower Gone
The Sounding Knob tower now stands once again on Jack Mountain
evidence.quote: it now stands once again on Jack Mountain

evidence.supports: The Sounding Knob tower was disassembled in 2002

corrections.why: The Association's list gives the type as Unknown, and Forest Lookouts calls the 1928 site a lookout station. No source read says it was a tower.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one Forest Lookouts page (a 1928 Highland Recorder item), the Association list, and a 2017 Allegheny Mountain Radio piece about Sounding Knob, used only to rule out a conflation. The brief's Association point (38.42428, -79.50149) is kept as the working location. The record's second point (38.4166, -79.5036, from the Forest Lookouts field) does not appear in the cached Forest Lookouts text read here, so it is not verified. The listsofjohn peak page returned HTTP 403 and is not used. The 1928 station and the Sounding Knob tower (built in 1934, per the Allegheny Mountain Radio piece) may or may not share ground; no source read says. Next check: Highland County or Forest Service records for the 1928 station's structure and removal date.
